...
Green goggles can't see the map. That's how they're designed.
Why? Obviously, it's to stop you from escaping!
...You're asking if you'll be free once you've eliminated all the targets? Probably.
But what happens after that? Another mission?

But there's another option.
Ta-da! Red goggles!

They let you see what you normally can't!
And they're only 99,900 credits!

...Wait, you seriously don't know?
Fine. The explanation's free.

You know the three primary colors of light, right?
Red, blue, and green.

What you can see depends on the color.
Your goggles restrict your vision.

For example, with red goggles...
you can see outside. Through that window.

Blue lets you see people.
People, not machines.
Works for me. I don't get many people to talk to.
And it's been a while since I've had a sucker... I mean, a customer!
Anyway, think about it. You can keep doing what Orbis tells you...

Or...
you can become truly free.

A terminal connected to an
unauthorized trading network...

Please select an
item to purchase.

It's a damaged maintenance pod.
...It still seems operational. What should you do?
After the maintenance, you feel somewhat better.
...It looks like you'll need to disable the safety system to activate it.
You violated safety protocols, but somehow you feel stronger.
...! There were credits inside the pod.
The maintenance pod has stopped working.

...It's a protocol that looks like a router.
What should you do?

..!
A new ability has been added.

You forcefully integrate it into your core.
You feel... somehow stronger.

You discard the router—no, the protocol.
The system feels more stable.
